凤辞醒过来的时候，时笙正站在岩石外面，仰着头看着上方。

“小殊……”凤辞看清她的身影，突然从地上一跃而起，闪到她身边，从后面搂住她，“幸好你没事。”

“咳咳咳……”时笙被抱了个措手不及，剧烈的咳嗽起来，淡淡的血腥味在两人间流转开。

“你怎么了？”凤辞放开时笙，转到她面前，“脸色怎么这么白？你的修为怎么没有了？是不是那些人……别怕，我帮你报仇，你想他们怎么死，他们就怎么死。”

时笙喘了一口气，余光扫到上面，脸色突然变了变，但还是说不出话，只能指了指上面。

凤辞暗红色的瞳孔中满是担忧，时笙这动作让他很不解，略带迷茫的看着她。

时笙胸口快速的起伏了几下，突然拽着他往旁边一闪，后面一声重物落地的声音。时笙背靠着墙，凤辞因为惯例压在了她身上，微凉的唇瓣正好碰到她唇角。

凤辞睁着一双大眼，长长的睫毛轻颤，两人的距离极近，能听到彼此的呼吸声。

凤辞突然偏了偏头，在时笙唇瓣上轻啄了一下，然后触电一般的跳开，目光游移向旁边，耳尖微微泛红。

时笙愣了一下，随后扯着嘴角轻笑，牵扯到内伤，她顿时苦了一张脸。

这么折腾，本宝宝这伤是好不了吧！

“扶我一下。”时笙气若游丝的冲凤辞伸出手。

凤辞面上都染上了红晕，小心的扶着时笙，视线不敢看她。凤辞心底很忐忑，她会不会生气？她会不会离开自己？

不管，她只能陪着他，如果她要离开自己，他就……

凤辞突然有些迷茫，她真的要离开自己，他该拿她怎么办呢？如果是以前，他会毫不犹豫的将她关起来，可是……

把她关起来，她一定会生气的，他不喜欢她生气，他喜欢她冲自己笑。

短短的几秒，时笙完全不知道凤辞内心已经转了好几道弯。

时笙正看着他们刚才站的地方，那里是两条交缠在一起的蛇，它们忘我的纠缠着，不时发出‘嘶嘶’的声音，似乎完全没注意到，就在它们不远的地方站着两个人。

凤辞看到那两条蛇，顿时黑了脸，将时笙的眼睛捂住，“不许看。”

时笙：“……”

该看的都看了，现在捂眼睛有毛用啊！

她刚才看的就是这两条蛇，尼玛挂在上面的一颗树上啪啪，高难度啊！

谁知道凤辞过来的时候，两条蛇突然就开始往下掉了。

When Feng Ci woke up, Shi Sheng was standing outside the rock, looking up at the top.

"Xiao Shu..." Feng Ci saw her figure clearly, suddenly jumped up from the ground, rushed to her side, and hugged her from behind, "Fortunately you are okay."

"Cough cough cough..." Shi Sheng was caught off guard and coughed violently, and the faint smell of blood spread between the two of them.

"What's wrong with you?" Feng Ci let go of Shi Sheng and turned to face her, "Why is your face so pale? Why is your cultivation gone? Are those people... don't be afraid, I will help you get revenge. They will die how you want them to die."

Shi Sheng took a breath and glanced at it with his peripheral vision. His face suddenly changed, but he was still speechless and could only point at it.

Feng Ci's dark red pupils were full of worry. Shi Sheng's actions puzzled him and he looked at her slightly confused.

Shi Sheng's chest rose and fell rapidly a few times, and then he suddenly pulled him to the side, followed by the sound of a heavy object falling to the ground.Shi Sheng's back was leaning against the wall, and Feng Ci pressed on her because of routine, and his slightly cool lips just touched the corner of her lips.

Feng Ci opened her big eyes and her long eyelashes trembled slightly. The distance between the two was so close that they could hear each other's breathing.

Feng Ci suddenly tilted his head, pecked Shi Sheng on the lips, and then jumped away as if he was electrocuted. His eyes wandered to the side, and the tips of his ears turned slightly red.

Shi Sheng was stunned for a moment, and then smiled softly. It involved internal injuries, and she suddenly had a grimace on her face.

After all this trouble, my baby’s injury will never heal!

"Help me." Shi Sheng stretched out his hand to Feng Ci angrily.

Feng Ci's face was covered with blush, and she carefully supported Shi Sheng, not daring to look at her.Feng Ci felt very uneasy. Would she be angry?Will she leave herself?

No matter, she can only stay with him. If she wants to leave her, he will...

Feng Ci was suddenly confused. She really wanted to leave him. What should he do with her?If it were before, he would lock her up without hesitation, but...

Lock her up, she will definitely be angry, he doesn't like her to be angry, he likes her to smile at him.

In just a few seconds, Shi Sheng had no idea that Feng Ci's heart had already turned several corners.

Shi Sheng was looking at the place where they were standing just now. There were two intertwined snakes. They were entangled selflessly and made hissing sounds from time to time. They seemed not to notice at all that there were two people standing not far from them.

When Feng Ci saw the two snakes, his face turned dark and he covered Shi Sheng's eyes, "Don't look at them."

Shi Sheng: "..."

I’ve seen everything I need to see, there’s no use covering my eyes now!

What she was looking at just now were these two snakes. They were hanging on a tree and snapping. It was so difficult!

Who knew that when Feng Ci came over, the two snakes suddenly started to fall down.
